t: You're looking at the London Aquatics Centre, in Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park in Stratford. Inside are two 50-metre swimming pools and a 25-metre diving pool. Zaha Hadid designed it as one of the main venues of the 2012 Summer Olympics and Paralympics, where it hosted the swimming, diving and synchronised swimming. Hadid was born in Baghdad, studied mathematics, then joined the Architectural Association in 1972, and she used painting as a design tool. After significant modification, the centre opened to the public in March 2014.
